description: Qianwen Cloud desktop, mobile app, and WeChat Mini Program UI design skills for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Qianwen Cloud console, mobile app, and mini program UI rules.
interface.longDescription: Provides Codex skills for designing Qianwen Cloud-style desktop console, documentation, mobile app, mobile web, PWA, and WeChat Mini Program interfaces, including analytics, billing, API key management, request logs, settings, alerts, compact tables, mobile list cards, custom navigation, tab bars, bottom sheets, WeUI-compatible flows, status tags, charts, and documentation/help surfaces.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $qianwen-cloud-ui, $qianwen-cloud-mobile-ui, or $qianwen-cloud-miniprogram-ui to design a Qianwen Cloud-style interface.
